summary: Bloque A (cities + dual-currency delivery quote + express orders + admin City CRUD) end-to-end verified. Backend pytest 45/45 green (32 prior + 13 new for Bloque A in /app/backend/tests/test_bloque_a_cities_delivery.py). Public /api/public/cities returns 16 seeded ciudades (ES + MA) without auth and excludes Mongo _id; /api/cities requires auth (401 without token); /api/v1/calculate-delivery returns correct EUR fee (base+per_km*distance) for motorcycle/car/bicycle and MAD ≈ 10.87 × EUR (measured ratio ~10.87). Customer can POST /api/orders/express (order_type='express', business_id=null, persistence verified via GET); admin & unauth get 403/401. Admin City CRUD: create OK, duplicate name → 400, PATCH updates persist, DELETE removes; non-admin → 403. Frontend /presupuesto loads publicly, computes Algeciras→Tánger by car = 69,22 € and 752,39 د.م (ratio 10.87 ✓), same-city → quote-error 'El origen y el destino no pueden ser iguales'. CustomerDashboard 'Envío exprés' (data-testid express-quote-btn) correctly navigates to /presupuesto. Admin Dashboard (rendered at /dashboard for role=admin via App.js route guard) shows city-manager-card; full add → edit → delete-with-confirm cycle works, city-count goes 16 → 17 → 16. Google Maps placeholder error remains (expected, key not set).

issues: Google Maps 'Oops! Something went wrong.' overlay continues (placeholder REACT_APP_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY — expected). A friendlier fallback would improve UX.

action_items: (Optional/cosmetic) Same as iter 3: replace Google Maps error block with a friendlier placeholder until a real key is configured.

(Optional/cosmetic) Admin role logs in and is redirected to /dashboard which conditionally renders AdminDashboard — the route /admin also works but Auth.js sends every user to /dashboard. Not a bug; just a small UX inconsistency.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/cities.py correctly excludes _id via projection {'_id': 0} on every read.
geo.calculate_delivery_quote uses haversine + per-vehicle base/per_km/speed and applies ETA_TRAFFIC_FACTOR=1.3 with a 5-min minimum — formulas verified to within rounding by both pytest and live UI.
MAD conversion uses MAD_PER_EUR = 1/0.092 ≈ 10.8696; matches the 10.87× requirement (measured ratio 752.39 / 69.22 = 10.870).
models.ExpressOrderCreate accepts fee + optional distance_km/eta_mins/origin_city_id; routes/orders.create_express_order stamps order_type='express' and resolves city_name from city_id when provided.
admin_delete_city blocks deletion when there are non-terminal orders (status not in delivered/cancelled) for that city_id — correct guard.
Public /api/public/cities and /api/v1/calculate-delivery are intentionally unauthenticated; OK for the presupuesto landing flow but worth rate-limiting in production.
Auth.js post-login navigation lands every role on /dashboard; /admin route also resolves to AdminDashboard via role check. Works, just two entry points to the same view.
